source_scope: Only the assigned source image, anonymous box TSV, blind rules, generated crops and manifest were read; no first-reading material, witness, comparison or adjudication was consulted.
display_note: The existing rotated B003 crop was resized to 2200 pixels across solely for display; its coordinates and rotation were not changed and prepare_second.py was not rerun. B018 and B019 were displayed individually after an earlier combined output was truncated before their images appeared.
general: The boxes concern local extension and decomposition-group notation, revisions to the local-ring description, a henselian-trait insertion, and two connected extension diagrams. This is a visual diplomatic reading only; no proof or mathematical identity was checked. Doubt is preserved on crossed wording, the scope of the marginal cancellation, a few case/index readings, and several diagram heads.
